fixes.what: Chios is drawn as the Republic's own land 1275-1329 and 1346-1566, but two existing dossiers hold the island in those years: lordship-of-chios (type state, 1304-1329, found from byzantine-empire, 1329 loss to byzantine-empire) and maona-of-chios (type colony, 12 September 1346 to April 1566, 'drawn in Genoa's tint', 1566 loss to ottoman-empire). The author's report lists the Maona as a counterpart needing a dossier; it exists since 19 October.
fixes.why: Chios page (opened by the author and by me): 'the Genovese Benedetto I Zaccaria (1304)' took the island as a renewable concession; 'expelled the Zacharia family from the island (1329)'; the Maona's castle 'surrendered' on 12 September 1346. The Byzantine dossier's 1329 gain is from 'Zaccaria lordship of Chios', not from Genoa, and it has no 1275 or 1346 loss. Schema: a colony is 'drawn as a vassal tint of the metropole', so the land belongs in maona-of-chios, with a vassal relation in Genoa.
fixes.fix: Keep the 1275 gain (Republic page: 'In 1275 the Byzantine Empire granted the islands of Chios and Samos to Genoa') but end Genoa's own Chios in 1304 (loss, counterpart lordship-of-chios, Chios page, confidence 2) or justify keeping it; delete the 1329 loss (the land is the Zaccaria lordship's); replace the 1346-09 gain by vassal_start counterpart maona-of-chios and the 1566-04 loss by vassal_end counterpart maona-of-chios; take Chios out of the keyframe corrections for 1304-1329 and 1346-1566 (the Maona dossier draws it); move war 3 and war 9 belligerents to include maona-of-chios; drop the Maona and Gattilusio entries from counterparts_needing_dossiers (slugs maona-of-chios and gattilusi exist).
